title: Egg fried rice with peas and carrots
description: Day-old-style fried rice with scrambled egg, peas, carrot, green onion, soy sauce and sesame oil.
draft_note: Draft quantities: adjust them in the app. Cooking the rice ahead and chilling it gives the best texture.

steps.text: Dice the carrots, slice the green onions, mince the garlic and beat the eggs.
Cook the rice: bring 540 ml of water to a boil, add the rice, cover and simmer on low 15 minutes. Spread it out to cool.
Heat half the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat. Scramble the eggs until set with no liquid left, then set aside.

Add the remaining oil, the carrots and garlic and stir-fry 3 minutes. Add the rice, peas and soy sauce and fry until hot and starting to crisp, 5 minutes. Fold in the eggs, green onions and sesame oil.
Cool, then refrigerate in the containers.
Reheat covered, stirring halfway, until hot all the way through.
